m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: An Ice Dwarf? How dare you come here! Who are you?
I am Lars Frostbinder, and I come in peace.
Frostbinder? We know that name - all too well! The Ice Dwarves sent YOU to us? Why? To negotiate our surrender? We defy you!
No, wait! This Wizard and I have come to help you! The Lava Tube was sabotaged, okay? And when it failed, the Pumps died too.
Bat, the Son of Spider - he's the one doin' all this. He wants us to go to war, so we'll destroy Athanor and break the Chain of Ice and Fire!
Destroy the Paradox Chain? This is a trick - magic and Ice Dwarves cannae be trusted! Guards, silence these lies!
Killing me will not lower the lava lake or dispel the Elementals. But if my life is the price of peace, I will pay it.
Ye're a bold one, young dwarf. Bold indeed. What do ye propose?
My people are working to clear that Lava Tube right now. But the Ice Elementals'll make it tough for 'em. Can you turn the Steam Vents back on?
If only we could, lad! The way to the Steam Plant's blocked by the lava - there's no way to get to it and turn the steam back on.
We'll want to solve that problem, then. What can we do?
Not much, I fear. We've got our best workers trying to divert the flows - go and meet Haemish on the East Platform. See if ye can help him.
This Token vouches for ye, strangers, but only so far. The Praesidium's in closed session. We're in a state of emergency.
Wait! You must admit us! The fate of both of our peoples depends on it - if I don't deliver my message, Athanor itself could be destroyed!
Very well, Ice Dwarf. Go in if ye will. Talk to Gordon. But know this: if this is some kind of trick, your Ice Dwarves will pay dearly for it.
Ye came to talk to the Praesidium? Well go on in, then!
